comment: Conformance pack cases this engine renders differently from the spec model, one entry per cause with its open ticket. See tests/ConformancePackTest.php.

entries.cause: carve#5015 port: the blank before a child block is owned by a descendant in the model
the model folds an opener into the paragraph after a refused plus; this engine interrupts it
the model keeps a list tight across a blank after a fence a refused plus ended; this engine loosens it
a > + after a quote-attached paragraph: the model erases it at the end of input; this engine keeps it a letter
the model drops the + of a lazy marker line folded into a quote paragraph; this engine keeps it
